title: A · 杂志式合作档案
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied reference webpage into a NEW complete desktop cooperation webpage for the same Chinese university mountaineering club. Reference image role: incumbent visual identity ONLY, retaining its mountain outline logo, navigation type, cold-white/pine-green palette, Chinese typography voice, restraint and outdoor photography; replace the reference's content and composition with this new partnership surface.
Render the actual webpage edge to edge, no browser/window/desktop/device surround. A single full-length desktop-page image, approximately 1408 pixels wide and 3840 pixels tall (desktop layout, not mobile). Show the ENTIRE scroll from navigation to footer, high-fidelity finished website composition, crisp readable Chinese text, actual usable-looking links/buttons, generous editorial alignment, precise whitespace. It is a WEB PAGE, not a poster or advertising illustration.
Audience: outdoor brands and sponsors, also the university. Purpose: assess team foundation, all projects, benefits, process, contacts; obtain handbook at page bottom.
Established identity: cool white #F5F6F4 canvas, near-white #FCFDFC, pine green #315447 accent/buttons, ink #202923 text, muted #606B63, fine pale-green #D6DED8 rules, deep pine #17241F for bottom download section/footer, pale pine #B3CBC0 on dark. No bright yellow, no blue accent, no gradients/glass, no generic rounded card grid. Chinese light-background headings resemble Source Han Serif/Songti; body Source Han Sans, English small DM Sans. Retain small original outlined mountain club mark.
Header: left "川衡登山协会" with "CHUANHENG · SINCE 2018"; right nav "活动与足迹", "认识川衡", "川衡登山队", active underlined "合作", green "一起出发 ↗".
The SIX content sections must appear below the opening IN EXACT ORDER and all be fully visible; do not omit or replace any:
1. Team foundation/qualifications, numbered "01 / TEAM & QUALIFICATIONS", heading "扎实的准备，是合作的起点。". Concise identity "南方科技大学 · 川衡登山队", training summary "体能与耐力 / 绳索与保护 / 路线规划 / 团队协作". A clear evidence LIST or table, not certificates as real claims: rows "张三 | 初级户外指导员 | 资质示例", "李四 | 户外急救培训 | 经历示例", "王五 | 绳索技术训练 | 经历示例". Legible notice "人员与资质为示例，待正式资料替换。". No fabricated issuer seals/certification logos/awards/statistics.
2. ALL projects, "02 / PROJECTS", heading "让每一份支持，有清晰的去向。". Exactly THREE substantial HORIZONTAL photo-and-text project entries (not a three-card grid): "01 雪山攀登计划"; "02 攀冰专项计划"; "03 全年训练与领队培养". Each has "示例项目", project objective/date/support snippets and clear "了解项目 ↗". Use alpine/ice/forest training editorial images with "AI 示意影像". Fields: "目标与路线待确认", "计划时间待确认", "经费 / 装备 / 技术支持" as appropriate. No invented completed ascents, specific mountains, altitudes or sponsors.
3. Cooperation ways and benefits, "03 / PARTNERSHIP VALUE", heading "支持的方式，可以一起定义。". Three short inline support ways "单次项目支持 / 技术装备支持 / 全年训练合作". Then a fine-ruled COMPARISON TABLE with column headers "权益方向", "合作内容", "确认事项". Four rows "品牌展示 | 项目页面与内容展示 | 位置与授权"; "内容共创 | 训练与攀登内容记录 | 选题与交付"; "装备反馈 | 使用体验与反馈整理 | 试用与反馈范围"; "校园分享 | 校园交流与教育共建 | 主题与组织安排". Note "金额、数量与具体交付，洽谈确认。". No ticks implying guaranteed reach, no money tiers, no invented brand logos.
4. Process, "04 / HOW WE WORK", heading "从想法到同行，四步开始。". Clean FOUR-step horizontal timeline, labeled "01 初步沟通", "02 方案共拟", "03 书面确认", "04 执行与复盘", one short explanatory line under each.
5. Contact, "05 / CONTACT", heading "从一次沟通，开始下一段同行。". "张三 · 示例联系人", "合作邮箱：待配置", "微信：待配置". No fake working address/phone/QR, no form. Medium readable plain section.
6. FINAL PAGE CONTENT is prominent deep pine-green HANDBOOK DOWNLOAD region, "06 / PARTNERSHIP HANDBOOK", heading "把合作的可能，带回去慢慢看。". A compelling realistic A4 portrait booklet cover preview with pine-green/cold-white editorial cover: "川衡登山队", "合作手册", "资质 · 项目 · 权益 · 流程 · 联系", small "示例版". Alongside visibly clickable pale-green button "下载合作手册 PDF ↓", small "A4 竖版 · 6–8 页 · 示例版". This is visibly the last content block before footer.
Footer retain the club's deep-green identity, concise "山野很远，同路人很近。", "© 2026 川衡登山协会", small "演示版本 · AI 示意影像".
The opening headline text must be verbatim "一起，让下一次攀登发生。", eyebrow "CHUANHENG / PARTNERSHIP", subcopy "项目合作 · 装备支持 · 全年训练", actions "浏览合作项目 ↓" and "获取合作手册 ↓". Opening has enough visible working UI and chapter navigation to read as a partnership page, not a vague scenic hero. Preserve content specificity. Every section keeps actual information in readable type.

COMPOSITION A: Quiet editorial partnership dossier. Opening is an asymmetrical spread: giant dark-green Chinese serif headline spanning the upper-left 70 percent and partially crossing the internal column structure, one narrow alpine landscape crop aligned to the right, primary CTA grounded beneath headline, a full-width bottom contents rule listing the six numbered chapters. NO generic balanced split hero, no row of badge cards. Wide cold-white reading field. Qualifications has short left-side heading and larger right evidence list. The three project rows each show landscape images on the LEFT occupying 38 percent and text on the RIGHT, with clear thin separators. Alternate ordinary white and subtle green-tinted blocks for paced reading, generous rhythm. Benefits and process are orderly and spacious, then an elegant dark-green booklet download close. Dominant move is typographic editorial opening; all other sections calm. Show all six sections and footer on one long complete page.
approvedScope: Whole page except section 06; use B for section 06
